title: Seva In Gurbani
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: Seva is carried here from  toward please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels performing, transactional, dry, because it keeps seva inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Seva steadies when please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhan anik baar sarab kalaa samarath ||
lines.translation: I bow down, and fall to the ground in humble adoration, countless times, to the All-powerful Lord, who possesses all powers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ddolan te raakhahu prabhoo naanak dhe kar hath ||1||
lines.translation: Please protect me, and save me from wandering, God. Reach out and give Nanak Your Hand. ||1||
